title: Warehouse user validates the delivery of a confirmed sales order: stock goes down, the order reads fully delivered
_seedNote: the delivery comes from a confirmed sales order (J-SALES-01 confirms 5 Office Chairs for Azure Interior; 8 on hand makes it Ready)

seeds.name: deliveryNo
seeds.sql: SELECT t.Number AS n FROM Inventory.Transfer AS t WHERE t.Status = 'Ready' AND t/Inventory.Transfer_OperationType/Inventory.OperationType/Kind = 'Delivery' AND t/Inventory.Transfer_SalesOrder/Sales.SalesOrder/Number != NULL ORDER BY t.Number DESC LIMIT 1

seeds.name: orderNo
seeds.sql: SELECT t/Inventory.Transfer_SalesOrder/Sales.SalesOrder/Number AS n FROM Inventory.Transfer AS t WHERE t.Number = '{{deliveryNo}}'

steps.name: Open Inventory > Transfers: the delivery is listed
Open the delivery: Ready, the order's chairs reserved

oql.label: the delivery carries the order as its source document (shown in an input, which textPresent cannot read)
oql.sql: SELECT COUNT(t.ID) AS n FROM Inventory.Transfer AS t WHERE t.Number = '{{deliveryNo}}' AND t.SourceDocument = '{{orderNo}}'

oql.label: the delivery is done with a date
oql.sql: SELECT COUNT(t.ID) AS n FROM Inventory.Transfer AS t WHERE t.Number = '{{deliveryNo}}' AND t.Status = 'Done' AND t.DateDone != NULL

outcome.label: the sales order reads fully delivered
outcome.sql: SELECT COUNT(o.ID) AS n FROM Sales.SalesOrder AS o WHERE o.Number = '{{orderNo}}' AND o.DeliveryStatus = 'FullyDelivered'
